rows.caveat: VDBBench vendor-run snapshot 2026-05-28, AWS us-west-2; LAION 100M x 768d, unfiltered IDs-only topK=100 (reported recall@10). Latency is P99 at max concurrency, rounded to microseconds; QPS=376.007, query-only modeled search=$2.976/hour, USD/query=search USD/hour/(QPS x 3600), rounded to 12 decimals. Assumes sustained measured max QPS; excludes storage, ingest/write, and embedding; not the Oneiron corpus or host. Source: payloadSearch unfiltered/na ids_only + costModel.scenarios.single.points in page __NEXT_DATA__; not BEAM accuracy.
